task.description: Write real executing tests for the five event-store cases that have no coverage at unit or integration level: TC-ES-01-02 (append to non-existent instance -> InstanceNotFound), TC-ES-01-03 (append to COMPLETED instance -> InstanceTerminated / HTTP 409), TC-ES-01-04 (append to CANCELLED instance -> InstanceTerminated / HTTP 409), TC-ES-05-04 (registerType duplicate name+version -> DuplicateEventTypeVersion / HTTP 409), TC-ES-07-02 (archive returns count of moved rows). No mocks or stubs (DIRECTIVE T-1); per-test UUID fixtures; unconditional cleanup; fail clearly without BPM_TEST_DB_URL (GH #472, ISS-0154).
acceptance_criteria: All five test cases have executing tests asserting the required behavior
zig build exits 0 with no 'error set' output
python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration exits 0 with no BLOCKER

result.summary: Covered all five previously-untested event-store cases with real integration tests against PostgreSQL. TC-ES-07-02 exposed a genuine production defect: Store.archive() returned the count of retention POLICIES applied rather than rows moved (returned 1 where the spec requires 3); fixed by converting its five DELETE statements to RETURNING queries and counting rows. zig build exits 0 with no 'error set'; zig build test exits 0; both lints exit 0; all five tests mutation-verified.

issues.description: Pre-existing and NOT introduced here: TC-ES-08-04 and TC-ADP-01-03 in the same file fail both with and without these changes (verified by stashing). Additional event-store tests (TC-ES-02-02, TC-ES-04-01/02, TC-ES-06-01/02, TC-ES-07-01) flake intermittently — root cause observed directly: TestHarness.init() -> resetTestData() DELETEs all rows from events and instance_projections, and killIdleConnections reports 'cross-owner idle connections remain' when a sibling agent's test binary runs concurrently against the shared test DB. This is the known GH #366/#454 shared-database race, not a defect in the new tests.

tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json was line-synced (not regenerated): appending tests shifted every pre-existing UUID literal below the insertion point, un-suppressing 61 findings. Entries were re-stamped by matching (file, code, message) so all 225 baseline entries are preserved, zero new suppressions were added, and the 3 genuinely-new findings were fixed in source rather than suppressed. This follows the precedent set by ISS-0142 (RESOLVED).
